candidates.change_summary: Delete the line 'acc.balance = add_uint256(acc.balance, msg.value);' so the balance is not increased on Put.
Replace 'acc.balance = add_uint256(acc.balance, msg.value);' with 'acc.balance = add_uint256(acc.balance, 0);' so the balance is increased by zero instead of msg.value.
Delete the nonReentrant_ modifier from the Put function so that reentrant calls are possible, which may change balance accounting under reentrancy.
Delete the line 'locked_ = true;' from the nonReentrant_ modifier, removing the reentrancy lock and allowing reentrant calls that can alter Put's balance update.
Change the condition `block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime` to `block.timestamp>=acc.unlockTime`.
Remove the condition `block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime` from the if statement.
Delete the condition `acc.balance>=MinSum` from the if statement.
Remove the nonReentrant_ modifier from the Collect function.
Remove the require(!locked_) check from the nonReentrant_ modifier.
Replace the if-condition with true so Collect sends funds whenever unlocked without checking MinSum, balance >= _am, or unlockTime.
Replace the if-condition with checking only unlockTime, omitting the MinSum and balance checks.
Replace the if-condition with checking only balance >= _am, omitting MinSum and unlockTime checks.
Change the balance check from >= _am to > _am, so collecting exactly the full balance no longer succeeds.
Change the unlockTime check from > acc.unlockTime to >= acc.unlockTime, allowing collection at the exact unlock timestamp.
Replace the guard `if (_s)` with `if (true)` so the balance is deducted and message logged even if the external call fails.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage statement so successful collections no longer record a Collect message.
Move the balance deduction and log message to before the external value call, causing state to change before the recipient is invoked.
Delete the nonReentrant_ modifier from Collect, removing the reentrancy guard entirely.
Delete the require(!locked_) check in nonReentrant_, making the reentrancy lock ineffective.
Change the require to require(locked_), which inverts the lock check and breaks normal entry.
Delete the locked_ = true statement, so the lock is never set and reentrancy is not actually prevented.
Delete the locked_ = false statement, permanently locking the contract after the first guarded call.
Moved the balance update (acc.balance = sub_uint256(acc.balance, _am)) and log emission to AFTER the external call to msg.sender.
Replaced the balance sufficiency and timelock check with just a balance sufficiency check, removing the MinSum and unlockTime conditions.
Changed acc.balance update to use add_uint256 instead of sub_uint256, increasing the balance after a successful external call.
Deleted the require(!locked_) check in the nonReentrant_ modifier, allowing reentrancy.
Deleted the locked_ = true assignment in the nonReentrant_ modifier, removing the reentrancy lock.
